sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; as per Schedule

room_rent.note: Room category and rent limit specified in the policy schedule; proportional deduction applies if higher room availed

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered as per limits in policy schedule

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan; optional co-pay available under Basic Benefit Option 3.3.8 for premium discount; co-pay also triggered if First Notification (3.3.6) or Preferred Provider Network (3.3.7) conditions are breached

sub_limits.note: Sub-limits on specific medical expenses may be specified in the Schedule; wording does not enumerate fixed sub-limits in the base text

deductible.note: Aggregate deductible available as optional Super Top-up (Basic Benefit Option 3.3.9); no deductible in base plan

initial_waiting.note: Can be waived via optional Basic Benefit Option 3.3.16

ped_waiting.note: As per standard Excl01; reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific disease waiting period; can be reduced via optional Basic Benefit Options 3.3.12 (Comprehensive) or 3.3.13 (Essential); reduced waiting period as per Schedule

maternity.note: Maternity excluded under standard Excl18; ectopic pregnancy in-patient only is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus (3.3.3) is an optional Basic Benefit Option; percentage and cap specified in Schedule; no impact on accrual even if claim made

restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (3.3.2) is optional; available for related or related+unrelated conditions as per Schedule; does not trigger on first claim; unlimited restorations possible if Schedule so specifies

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days specified in Schedule

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days specified in Schedule

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered; list available at acko.com/gi

domiciliary.note: Reimbursement basis only; treating doctor must confirm medical necessity in writing

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to SI; OPD AYUSH not covered

organ_donor.note: In-patient hospitalization expenses of organ donor covered; pre/post-hosp of donor, donor screening, organ acquisition costs excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance and public transport for emergency covered at reasonable/customary charges; limit as per Schedule

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, intravitreal injections etc.

consumables.note: Non-payable/consumable expenses (Annexure 1 list including gloves, masks etc.) excluded by default; covered if Basic Benefit Option 3.3.10 (Waiver of non-payable expenses) is opted

global_cover.note: Worldwide in-patient hospitalization available as optional Basic Benefit Option 3.3.1; payment in INR at RBI exchange rate

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual; no claims for injury/accident during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; application must be received 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date

notable_exclusions: Maternity, dental (non-accident), hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, substance abuse, war/nuclear, external congenital anomaly, OPD (unless add-on opted)
optional_riders: Restore SI, Cumulative Bonus, NCB SI, Super Top-up, Worldwide cover, Waiver of non-payables, All medically necessary hospitalization, OPD services, Daily hospital cash, Accidental death/disability, Co-pay, Inflation Protect SI
